hints.why: Cast every time it was castable once unflagged (20 games, 2026-09-30) and activated 0 times: the shipped script has no AILogic on the sacrifice ability and no sacrifice preference, so the AI never finds a body to feed it. carrion_feeder.txt is Forge's own shape for exactly this ability.
Held castable on 32 own turns before the unflag; the same ability shape as Vish Kal with the same missing logic.

woe_strider.txt is Forge's shape for a sacrifice-to-scry outlet: fire it at an opponent's end step, feeding it tokens and one-drops so the drain triggers (Blood Artist, Cruel Celebrant) see the deaths.

A free outlet: the shipped mill logic computes X from the sacrificed creature's power before any creature is chosen, reads 0 and refuses every target — 32 of our own permanents died while it sat on the battlefield across six games, activated 0 times. SacOutlet (data/forge_patches/MillAi.java) fires when a creature of ours is about to die anyway (the engine's shouldSacrificeThreatenedCard) or is SacMe, aimed at the thinnest library. No AIPreference on purpose: the SacCost path then prefers the THREATENED creature before the profile's default fodder.

Held while castable on 29 own turns across 9 games and cast 0 times in 80: Forge's EffectAi casts an Effect spell only under a logic it implements, and none fit a protection spell. `Protection` (data/forge_patches/EffectAi.java) casts it against an opponent's board wipe on the stack, removal aimed at our commander, a spell that would take our life to zero, or lethal combat — the pilot's own uses of it (log 006: wipe after wipe).

Held while castable on 59 own turns across 13 games and cast 0 times in 80, while 17 opposing spells or abilities were aimed at our seat or our permanents: the shipped ChangeTargetsAi 'can't otherwise play this ability' and the AI's new-target chooser returned null. `Deflect` (data/forge_patches/ChangeTargetsAi.java + PlayerControllerAi.chooseNewTargetsFor) fires on an opponent's targeted spell aimed at us and sends it to the caster's best permanent, or the caster.
